How this stays easy to extend: every template below is a plain JSON "scene" (a list of layers with position/size/animation). Adding a new template means writing a new JSON object, not new rendering code — ask me to add one any time and it drops straight into the Templates list. New layer types (like the Map Pin marker) register the same way.
